common: Isolated on a plain light grey background, the whole thing visible and centred. Dark realistic Nordic folk-tale style, not cute. Matte, softly lit, no glow, no shadows on the ground.

looks.prompt: The body of a giant black widow spider with every leg removed, like a museum specimen without its legs: seen from the side and slightly above. A huge glossy jet-black round abdomen with a vivid red hourglass mark on its underside and a thin red stripe on top, joined by a narrow waist to a smaller black cephalothorax with eight small dark-red glinting eyes in two rows and two curved black fangs, fine short bristles, no legs at all.

The head and the first stretch of the neck of a lindorm, the great serpent dragon of Norwegian folklore, seen from the side and a little above: a long heavy reptile head with a broad flat skull, a powerful lower jaw with the mouth slightly open showing rows of yellowed fangs, small cold amber eyes under heavy bony brows, a short frill of torn fins behind the jaw, dark olive and bog-brown scales, paler belly scales under the jaw, strands of pondweed caught on it, the neck cut off cleanly behind the head. No legs, no wings.

One hump of the long body of a lindorm, the great serpent dragon of Norwegian folklore: a single arched loop of a huge scaled serpent body, as thick as a barrel, rising in an arch and both ends cut off flat at the same level at the bottom, like a coil rising out of water, dark olive and bog-brown scales on the back, a low ragged dorsal fin along the top of the arch, paler belly scales underneath, strands of pondweed caught on it.
